blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines — One Alas Pilipinas men’s beach volleyball team bowed out of the Asian Games after Lerry John Francisco and Ranran Abdilla lost to Oman’s Al Hashimi Mazin and Al Jalaboubi Hood, 21-14, 28-26, Thursday at Hekinan Ryokuchi Beach Court. Abdilla, playing with new partner Francisco, will miss the knockout round for the second straight Asian Games stint after going winless in Pool A. Abdilla and Francisco gave themselves a chance in the second set, holding three set points –the last at 22-21–and saving four match points before […]...
